proof_body:
by
  intro p q r u v w hpq hqr hpr
  have hs1 : (v - u) / (q - p) * (q - p) = v - u := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (sub_ne_zero.2 hpq.symm)
  have hs2 : (w - u) / (r - p) * (r - p) = w - u := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (sub_ne_zero.2 hpr.symm)
  generalize (v - u) / (q - p) = s1 at hs1
  generalize (w - u) / (r - p) = s2 at hs2
  have ha : (s2 - s1) / (r - q) * (r - q) = s2 - s1 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (sub_ne_zero.2 hqr.symm)
  generalize (s2 - s1) / (r - q) = a at ha
  refine ⟨(a, s1 - a * (p + q), u - a * p ^ 2 - (s1 - a * (p + q)) * p), ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only
    refine ⟨by ring, ?_, ?_⟩
    · linear_combination hs1
    · linear_combination hs2 + (r - p) * ha
  · rintro ⟨a', b', c'⟩ ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    dsimp only at h1 h2 h3
    have hp : a * p ^ 2 + (s1 - a * (p + q)) * p + (u - a * p ^ 2 - (s1 - a * (p + q)) * p) = u := by ring
    have hq : a * q ^ 2 + (s1 - a * (p + q)) * q + (u - a * p ^ 2 - (s1 - a * (p + q)) * p) = v := by
      linear_combination hs1
    have hr : a * r ^ 2 + (s1 - a * (p + q)) * r + (u - a * p ^ 2 - (s1 - a * (p + q)) * p) = w := by
      linear_combination hs2 + (r - p) * ha
    generalize hb : s1 - a * (p + q) = b at hp hq hr ⊢
    generalize hc : u - a * p ^ 2 - b * p = c at hp hq hr ⊢
    have e1 : (a' - a) * (p + q) + (b' - b) = 0 := mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hpq) (by linear_combination h1 - h2 - hp + hq : (p - q) * ((a' - a) * (p + q) + (b' - b)) = (p - q) * 0)
    have e2 : (a' - a) * (p + r) + (b' - b) = 0 := mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hpr) (by linear_combination h1 - h3 - hp + hr : (p - r) * ((a' - a) * (p + r) + (b' - b)) = (p - r) * 0)
    have e3 : a' - a = 0 := mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hqr) (by linear_combination e1 - e2 : (q - r) * (a' - a) = (q - r) * 0)
    have e4 : a' = a := by linarith
    subst e4
    have e5 : b' = b := by linarith
    subst e5
    have e6 : c' = c := by linarith
    subst e6
    rfl
